entries.4b0c71e7e9d62f21: This business plans, develops and sells cosmetics and health foods made from the thin membrane inside a chicken eggshell (eggshell membrane), and it is the Company's single business category. The securities report states that all manufacturing of foods and cosmetics is outsourced to external contractors. Because it is a single business, segment information is not disclosed, and the securities report explains the business's characteristics by sales channel. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,118,869 thousand (up 19.4% year on year), and operating profit was ¥685,387 thousand (down 27.6%). Revenue increased owing to the acquisition of new customers in direct sales (EC) and an increase in the number of stores carrying products in external sales (general distribution), while external sales (OEM sales) and TV shopping decreased; operating profit declined, also owing to an increase in advertising expenses.

entries.50f98d74202e33d1: This is sales in which the company receives orders directly from end consumers through its own EC site and other companies' EC sites, and delivers the products. The main products are the CELLULA series of cosmetics and others. Since it started a subscription service on its own EC site in April 2018, the number of regular customer members has tended to increase, reaching 126,000 as of the end of March 2026. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, its share of revenue was 73.3% (141.1% of the same period of the previous year), the largest of the 4 sales channels. Manufacturing of food and cosmetics is entirely outsourced to contract manufacturers, and the company concentrates on planning, development and sales. Sales are conducted through four channels: direct sales (EC) through its own EC site and others, TV shopping, external sales (OEM sales) and external sales (general distribution); in the fiscal year ended March 2026, direct sales (EC) accounted for 73.3% of sales. Sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥10,118,869 thousand (up 19.4% year on year).

entries.a8c444e6187c1861: Eggshell membrane is a thin membrane inside chicken eggshells, and the annual securities report states that special processing is required because the body cannot easily absorb its components as they are. The company produces eggshell membrane raw material using fine grinding and hydrolysis technologies, and combines these with food processing and cosmetics processing technologies to create cosmetics and health foods. The report states that manufacturing is outsourced to contract manufacturers and that audits of those manufacturers are conducted regularly. The company also continues joint research with universities and others.
